pullRequest.method: per file, the added and removed lines of each head's diff against its own merge base, compared

method.live: the toggle is clicked inside the page and every animation frame for 700 ms reads the edges; frames and gaps are counted over the first 400 ms
method.seek: after the click, once the animations exist and their count holds for one frame, every animation is paused and set to 0, 25, 50, 75 and 100% of 300 ms
method.navEdge: the nav element's box cut by every ancestor's clip-path inset and every ancestor's overflow box
method.contentEdge: the role="main" element's box, which includes its translate
method.gap: the content's top minus the top nav's visible bottom, and the content's left minus the side nav's visible right
method.interleaved: each case runs on the passed head and then on the head, in one browser session

cases.label: Hidden Side Nav Section (stock): side nav
